lyricConnections.explanationJa: take a chance は、うまくいくか分からなくても思い切って挑戦すること。ここでは二人でダンスを試す。
No need to rush は『急がなくていい』。緊張している相手を安心させる言い方。
next to you は『あなたの隣に』。歌と同じく、相手のそばにいる心地よさを伝える。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: I should warn you, I've got two left feet.
sentences.displayHtml: I should warn you, I've got two left feet.

sentences.text: You might regret asking me to come.
sentences.displayHtml: You might regret asking me to come.

conversation.japanese: 先に言っておくけど、僕、ダンスはからっきしだよ。誘ったのを後悔するかも。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: I figured we could take a chance on something new.
sentences.displayHtml: I figured we could take a chance on something new.

conversation.japanese: じゃあ、二人で下手なまま楽しもう。何か新しいことを思い切ってやってみたくて。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Okay, but everyone else already knows the steps.
sentences.displayHtml: Okay, but everyone else already knows the steps.

conversation.japanese: 分かった。でも、ほかの人はもうステップを知ってるよ。どっちに動くの？

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Here, take my hand and just follow me.
sentences.displayHtml: Here, take my hand and just follow me.

conversation.japanese: 急がなくていいよ。ほら、手を取って、私についてきて。

conversation.speaker: A

sentences.text: Actually, being next to you makes this a lot less embarrassing.
sentences.displayHtml: Actually, being next to you makes this a lot less embarrassing.

conversation.japanese: 君の隣にいると、思ったほど恥ずかしくないな。

conversation.speaker: B

sentences.text: Good, because I was hoping this could become our Friday thing.
sentences.displayHtml: Good, because I was hoping this could become our Friday thing.

conversation.japanese: よかった。これから金曜は二人で通えたらいいなって思ってたんだ。
